title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-28
lineage: Master Reel (Teac A-6100) -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Fostex FR-2LE -> WAV (24bit/96k)  Mastering Info: WAV -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/24
source: SBD -> Shure Line Mixers -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Master Reel (Sony Deck - BASF Tapes - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a soaring 1971 performance featuring rich vocal harmonies, an iconic "That's It For the Other One" jam, and inspired set‑list flow.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear mix that highlights deep, richly layered vocals and trippy keyboard textures, marking it as one of the best soundboard releases. Musically the show shines with standout moments like the monster "That's It For the Other One" sequence, a beautifully jammed Dark Star, and a memorable Wharf Rat, all delivered with high energy and inspired song selection.

ai_rating.rationale: All five‑star reviews uniformly praise both the performance and audio quality; no criticisms are noted, indicating an exceptional show captured on an excellent soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, detailed mix with deep vocal richness, balanced instrumentation, and crisp keyboard presence; no reported drop‑outs or muffiness.

standout_songs: That's It For the Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Inspired tune selection that weaves strong stand‑alone numbers with expansive jams, creating a cohesive and engaging set.

band_member_comments.Keys: Trippy keyboard work noted and praised by reviewers.
